from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import SecureFolderNode

class FolderBreadcrumbView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, node_id):
        node = get_object_or_404(SecureFolderNode, id=node_id, workspace=request.user.workspace)
        ancestors = node.get_ancestors(include_self=True)
        breadcrumbs = [{"id": a.id, "name": a.name} for a in ancestors]
        return Response({"breadcrumbs": breadcrumbs})
